## Description

Trade temporary divergence between correlated ETFs or between an ETF and a related benchmark.

## Where it may fit

Liquid markets with synchronized price formation and short-lived relative dislocations.

## Vehicles

Index and sector ETFs; sometimes index futures versus ETFs.

## Required data

Minute/tick prices, synchronized timestamps, ETF NAV/holdings or benchmark, spreads, fees and latency.

## Caveats

Apparent mispricing may be stale quotes, component-market timing or feed latency—not a tradable edge.
